'''Politics and elections'''
*[[By-elections to the 45th Canadian Parliament]]

***[[Conservative Party of Canada]] leader [[Pierre Poilievre]] is elected in a by-election in [[Battle River—Crowfoot]], and returns to the [[House of Commons of Canada|House of Commons]] and his role as [[Leader of the Official Opposition (Canada)|opposition leader]] after [[Carleton in the 2025 Canadian federal election|previously losing re-election]] during the [[2025 Canadian federal election]] in [[Carleton (Ontario federal electoral district)|Carleton]].
